shared_elements: human and animal imagery combined on one surface
justification: Both surfaces depict human heads together with animal heads, but that is a generic coincidence: A shows a narrative procession of profile human figures with elaborately patterned hair and beards leading horned, fleecy rams, while B shows frontal, blocky, schematic heads stacked vertically with a toothy animal-like head above a staring human face. There is no shared relationship, arrangement or rendering convention — profile relief narrative versus frontal columnar stacking of masks.
